## Inspecting the output

There are many ways to inspect the output. Below are the commands I currently use to quickly check each classification generated by `preliminaryA.py`.

### 1. Keep (polyA candidates)

Count the number of retained reads:

```bash
grep -c 'status=keep' data/temp/pre1k.fa
```

output: `675`

View the first few retained reads:

```bash
grep -A1 'status=keep' data/temp/pre1k.fa | head -10
```

output: 

```
>e0dba5d0-6f1c-4d7b-9c82-8ff85f3550ac status=keep type=polyT lenA=22 len_read=472
ATTCGTGAGACTTGCCTGTATTGTTTGTATTCTCGTTGTTCTTGTGAGTGTAATGTGGCGTTAATGAAATATGATTCAATAAAATAAAACCTTTTTAGTTAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
>976d29dc-8666-41fe-9fdf-8ec7dbd57ee9 status=keep type=polyT lenA=18 len_read=529
TTTTATGAGATCATATCATATGTTCCAATCTTATTTTGCTCTCTCTATCATTGGTGAAAAGTCAAACACATTTCTGAAAAGTAAGAAATTGTTTTTCTTGAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
>e61fdbfd-bcb3-4c9b-b34b-8e9f6c952c58 status=keep type=polyT lenA=33 len_read=471
TTTTTTAAATCTCTGGGTATGTAGTAGTAAGAGTAGTAGAACTTGTACTTAAAAAAGAATGTTGTGTTCTTTAAGCTTATTATTATGTGTGTTGCGAACTAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
--
>49fa6fba-28a3-4889-b324-880e6e80b971 status=keep type=polyA lenA=19 len_read=368
TCTTCTGTACAACTCTTTCATTCTTAAGATAATATTCTTTAGTATGATCTTTTGTTTGCAAAACGATTACAAGCTATATAAAAGGATCCAACTTTACACGAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
```

### 2. Reject: both

Count reads containing both a poly(A) and poly(T) run:

```bash
grep -c 'reason=both' data/temp/pre1k.fa
```

output: `4`

View examples:

```bash
grep -A1 'reason=both' data/temp/pre1k.fa | head -10
```

output: 


### 3. Reject: neither

Count reads without a qualifying poly(A) or poly(T) run:

```bash
grep -c 'reason=neither' data/temp/pre1k.fa
```

output: `320`

View examples:

```bash
grep -A1 'reason=neither' data/temp/pre1k.fa | head -10
```

output:

```
>b066f69a-4698-4898-ad43-e1ecb2b4b5ab status=reject reason=neither len_read=489

--
>d2589188-4cac-46a0-b83b-5074f52b8977 status=reject reason=neither len_read=616

--
>cba5ec8f-e5b2-40a4-afaf-407c49cb0439 status=reject reason=neither len_read=583

```

---

### 4. Reject: short

Count reads with insufficient upstream transcript sequence (<100nt) for extraction:

```bash
grep -c 'reason=short' data/temp/pre1k.fa
```

Output: 1

View examples:

```bash
grep -A1 'reason=short' data/temp/pre1k.fa
```

Output:

```
>030fc005-9987-4ecc-9bac-d0b408c3110d status=reject reason=short len_read=457

```
